description: Baseline: locked real-config soak benchmark and correctness gates

asi.hypothesis: Establish stable real-config CPU baseline while preserving 90 ms cadence and visual behavior.
asi.workload: Three 3-second Snacks dashboard soaks after 1-second warmup; median CPU; default grudge_axe glitch; 10-13 FPS gate.
asi.anti_cheat: Benchmark and checks locked; cadence, timer cleanup, generation, and lifecycle behavior enforced.
asi.finding: Baseline CPU 4.975%; full redraw p95 7.122 ms; section serialization 798.5 µs and 146.1 KiB/call.
